decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Ground floor plan existing dD - ELW - 101, Loft plan dD - ELW - 103, Elevations & Sections Proposed dD - ELW - 212, First floor plan existing dD - ELW - 102, Elevations & Sections Existing dD - ELW - 201, Roof Plan Existing dD - ELW - 104, Site Plan Existing dD - ELW - 002, First Floor Plan Proposed dD - ELW - 112, Elevations & Sections Proposed dD - ELW - 211, Elevations & Sections Existing dD - ELW - 202, Roof Plan Proposed dD - ELW - 114, Loft Plan Proposed dD - ELW - 113, Ground Floor Plan Proposed dD - ELW - 111, Site Plan Existing dD - ELW - 002 and Location Plan dD - ELW - 001) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension, conversion of the garage into a habitable room and installation of three front and rear roof windows to the house
